title: Commercial Property Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant
Salary: Competitive, depending on experience

An established Yorkshire law firm is looking for a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join its team in Barnsley.

This is an opportunity to support a varied commercial property caseload within a firm with more than 100 years of history. The team handles a broad range of work, including commercial sales and purchases, leases, new build matters, and investor and refinancing work.

What will you be doing?
- Providing day-to-day administrative and legal support to the commercial property team
- Assisting with commercial property sales and purchases
- Helping to prepare and organise legal documents and transaction paperwork
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, agents and other third parties
- Supporting the progression of matters and keeping files and case management systems up to date
- Managing correspondence, arranging meetings and maintaining accurate records

What are we looking for?
- Previous experience working in commercial property law is essential
- Experience in a legal assistant, secretary or paralegal role within a commercial property team
- Strong organisation and communication skills, with good attention to detail
- A confident and professional approach when dealing with clients and other contacts
- The ability to manage competing tasks and work well as part of a team

Applications from candidates without previous commercial property experience may not be suitable for this role.

Why apply?
- Join an established Yorkshire firm with more than a century of history
- Gain exposure to a varied range of commercial property matters
- Work in a firm that values a personal and approachable service
- Develop your experience within a specialist area of property law

If you have previous experience supporting commercial property matters and are interested in this opportunity in Barnsley, please get in touch to find out more.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Location: Barnsley
Job Type: Permanent
Career Progression: Full training and opportunity to qualify

Are you a law graduate or an aspiring legal professional looking to build a career in property law?

A growing specialist property law firm in Barnsley is looking to recruit a Conveyancing Assistant to join its expanding practice. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to gain practical legal experience, learn directly from an experienced legal professional and develop towards a more advanced role over time.

Previous conveyancing experience is welcome but not essential. The firm is happy to consider recent graduates and candidates with some relevant experience who have the right attitude, are keen to learn and want to build a long-term career in the legal sector.

The Role

Initially, the position will focus on supporting the day to day within the department. You will work closely with the firm's founder, receiving hands on training and guidance while developing your understanding of property law and the conveyancing process.

As your knowledge and confidence grow, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and progress into more advanced legal work, with the longer term possibility of working towards qualification.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Opening new files and completing initial administrative tasks
- Providing updates on matters and helping maintain clear communication
- Supporting the day-to-day administration of the property law practice
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring files are kept up to date
- Learning the firm's systems, processes and working methods
- Taking on additional duties and more advanced work as your experience develops

About You

The firm is open to applications from a range of backgrounds, including recent law graduates and candidates already working in legal administration or conveyancing.

You will ideally have:
- A law degree or some experience in a legal environment
- Strong organisational skills and good attention to detail
- Clear communication skills and a professional approach
- A willingness to learn and take direction from an experienced legal professional
- A positive attitude towards starting with administrative responsibilities and developing from there
- A genuine interest in building a long-term career in property law

Previous conveyancing experience is not essential. The firm is more interested in finding someone with the right attitude, commitment and potential to develop.

This is an opportunity to join a growing specialist property law practice where you can learn from the ground up, gain valuable hands-on experience and work towards developing a career in conveyancing.

If you are a recent graduate or an aspiring legal professional looking for a role with genuine development potential, apply today or contact Legal to find out more.

title: Family Legal Secretary
description:
Family Legal Secretary

Location: Barnsley, South Yorkshire

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Job Type: Permanent

Hours: Full time, Monday to Friday

A well-established law firm in Barnsley is looking to recruit an experienced Family Legal Secretary to join its busy Family Law team.

This is a great opportunity for a Legal Secretary, Family Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant with previous experience in Family Law who is looking to join a supportive and established team.

The Role

Working alongside experienced Family Solicitors, you will provide day to day secretarial and administrative support across a varied Family Law caseload.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Providing legal secretarial support to Family Solicitors.
- Preparing and formatting legal correspondence and documentation.
- Typing letters, statements, applications and other legal documents.
- Managing diaries, appointments and deadlines.
- Opening and maintaining client files.
- Liaising with Clients, Solicitors, Barristers, courts and other third parties.
- Handling incoming calls and emails and dealing with client queries professionally.
- Assisting with the administration of Family Law matters, including divorce, financial matters and private children work.
- Supporting Solicitors with general administrative tasks and case management.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience working as a Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant within Family Law.
- Good knowledge of Family Law terminology and procedures.
- Strong typing, administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to manage deadlines and prioritise a busy workload.
- A professional and client focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Experience within a Family Law department is preferred, although candidates with strong legal secretarial experience and an interest in Family Law will also be considered.

What's on Offer?
- Permanent Family Legal Secretary position in Barnsley.
- Established and supportive Family Law team.
- Varied workload and regular client contact.
- Opportunity to develop your legal secretarial experience.
- Competitive salary based on experience.
- Friendly and professional working environment.

If you are an experienced Family Legal Secretary, Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Barnsley or South Yorkshire, this could be an excellent opportunity to join an established legal team.

Apply now or contact Dan Craddock at G2 Legal Recruitment for a confidential discussion about the role.

title: Family Legal Secretary - Sheffield
description:
Family Legal Secretary - Sheffield, South Yorkshire Full Time Permanent Competitive Salary + Excellent Benefits

An excellent opportunity has arisen for a motivated and organised Family Legal Secretary to join the established Family Law department of a highly regarded law firm in Sheffield.

This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of one of the UK's largest Family Law teams, providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support to experienced solicitors handling a broad range of family and children law matters.

Previous experience within Family Law, Matrimonial Law or Child Care Law would be advantageous, although applications are also welcomed from experienced Legal Secretaries with a background in other practice areas who are keen to develop their careers in Family Law.

Comprehensive training, ongoing support and genuine opportunities for career progression are available.

The Role Working closely with solicitors and other members of the Family Law team, you will provide comprehensive legal secretarial and administrative support across a varied caseload, including divorce, separation, children matters, care proceedings and financial settlements.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Providing professional and compassionate client care, handling telephone calls, emails and face-to-face enquiries.
- Preparing and formatting legal correspondence, statements and court documentation.
- Producing and organising court bundles for Family Court hearings.
- Audio typing, note taking and general legal document production.
- Managing diaries, appointments and meetings with clients, barristers and other professionals.
- Opening new client files, completing onboarding procedures and maintaining accurate records using the firm's case management system.
- Liaising with solicitors and other legal professionals regarding case progression.
- Keeping clients informed and ensuring enquiries are dealt with promptly and sensitively.
- Maintaining accurate electronic and paper files.
- Handling confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.

About You The successful candidate will be an organised, approachable and proactive individual who enjoys working in a busy legal environment and delivering excellent client service.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary, Legal Administrator or Legal Assistant.
- Experience within Family Law, Matrimonial Law or Children Law, although this is not essential.
- Strong audio typing and document production skills.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Experience using legal case management systems.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively to deadlines.
- A professional, empathetic and discreet approach when dealing with sensitive client matters.

Applications are particularly encouraged from Legal Secretaries who are interested in moving into Family Law and developing specialist knowledge within a supportive department.

Salary & Benefits The firm offers a competitive salary alongside an excellent benefits package, including:
- 23 days' annual leave for support staff, increasing with service to a maximum of 28 days.
- 3 additional discretionary days over Christmas, plus bank holidays.
- Flexible working arrangements, subject to the requirements of the role.
- Flexi-time opportunities and up to 4 additional flex days per year.
- Contributory pension scheme.
- Group Life Assurance after qualifying service.
- Enhanced support through sick pay and contractual maternity pay provisions.
- Excellent training, professional development and internal progression opportunities.
- Employee recognition and referral reward schemes.
- Access to wellbeing initiatives and staff social events.
- Optional benefits including healthcare, Cycle to Work and staff savings schemes.

Apply Now If you are an experienced Legal Secretary, Family Legal Secretary, Matrimonial Legal Secretary or Legal Administrator looking for an opportunity to join a respected and supportive law firm in Sheffield, I would be delighted to hear from you.

Whether you already have Family Law experience or are looking to move into this rewarding area of legal practice, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

Please get in touch for a confidential discussion or send your CV to find out more.

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
Role: Litigation Paralegal
Location: Sheffield, South Yorkshire
Contract: Full time, permanent
Salary: £23,000 - £27,000

As a Litigation Paralegal within this established in-house legal team, you will play a vital role in managing legal recovery claims relating to commercial property and infrastructure damage. Working within a structured, high-volume environment, your duties will include:
- Monitoring Incoming Claims: Regularly review and assess new damage claims submitted by external stakeholders, contractors, or third parties, ensuring accuracy and completeness of information.
- Case Management: Handle a personal caseload of legal recovery files from initial instruction through to final resolution. Use internal systems to track progress, maintain documentation, and ensure compliance with service level agreements.
- Claim Evaluation & Qualification: Conduct early-stage analysis of claims to determine liability, legal merit, and potential recovery value. Ensure cases meet the required thresholds for progressing to litigation where necessary.
- Negotiation & Settlement: Engage with third parties, insurers, and legal representatives to negotiate out-of-court settlements wherever possible, while protecting the organisation's commercial interests.
- Litigation Support: Where disputes cannot be resolved through negotiation, prepare case files for formal legal proceedings. This includes drafting pleadings, witness statements, and other relevant legal documents.
- Evidence Gathering: Undertake detailed investigative work by analysing technical documents, reviewing planning maps and diagrams, and liaising with internal operational teams to gather essential case facts.
- Client Liaison & Stakeholder Communication: Maintain regular contact with internal departments and external parties, including engineers, surveyors, contractors, and claims specialists, to ensure consistent information flow throughout the claims process.
- Compliance & Risk Awareness: Ensure that all casework is conducted in line with relevant legislation, regulatory standards, and internal policy. Proactively flag potential legal risks or anomalies to supervising solicitors.
- Use of Case Management Systems: Utilise specialist case management software to manage documentation, record actions, and produce reports. Contribute to data accuracy and overall operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:

To be considered for this role, applicants must have:
- Previous experience in a legal setting
- Exposure to civil or commercial litigation
- The ability to handle a high volume of cases with efficiency and accuracy

title: Personal Injury Legal Assistant
description:
Role: Personal Injury Legal Assistant
Location: Sheffield, South Yorkshire
Contract: Full time, permanent
Salary: £24,000 - £26,000

CRA Consulting is pleased to be working alongside a leading claimant law firm in Sheffield to recruit a Personal Injury Legal Assistant to join its growing team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in Personal Injury, legal administration or paralegal work who is looking to develop their technical knowledge and take on greater responsibility within a busy claimant environment.
The role will initially involve supporting the team across a range of Personal Injury matters, with the opportunity to transition into Data Breach and GDPR-related claims as your experience develops.

The Role
As a Legal Assistant, you will be hands-on with live matters and closely involved in progressing claims from initial instruction through to resolution. You'll work alongside experienced fee earners and solicitors, gaining exposure to the wider claims process and taking on increasing responsibility as you develop.
Your duties will include:
- Assisting with the day-to-day progression of Personal Injury claims
- Liaising with clients, insurers, medical professionals and other third parties
- Preparing and reviewing legal documentation and correspondence
- Obtaining and reviewing supporting evidence and medical records
- Assisting with drafting statements and other case documentation
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date case records
- Managing key dates, deadlines and ongoing case actions
- Supporting fee earners with the progression of litigated and pre-litigation matters
- Developing an understanding of Data Breach and GDPR claims, with a view to transitioning into this area of work
- Taking on increased responsibility for your own caseload as your knowledge and confidence develops

Progression into Data Breach
A key part of the opportunity is the genuine progression into Data Breach work.
You'll receive support and training to develop your understanding of claims arising from data breaches and GDPR infringements, including the impact these incidents can have on individuals. The Legal Assistants within the team are very involved in the progression of matters, so this is much more than a traditional administrative support role.

Over time, there is the opportunity to take on more responsibility and develop your own expertise within this specialist area.
About You
The firm is open to candidates from a range of backgrounds, but you are likely to have:
- Previous experience within a legal environment
- Ideally, some exposure to Personal Injury, claimant work or litigation
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to manage a busy workload and work to deadlines
- A genuine interest in developing your legal knowledge and taking on greater responsibility
- A proactive and client-focused approach

This could suit an experienced Legal Assistant, Paralegal or Personal Injury support professional who is looking for a role offering hands-on experience, specialist training and genuine career progression.
The Opportunity

You'll be joining an established team in Sheffield with the opportunity to build on your existing legal experience and develop specialist knowledge in an area of growing importance.
For the right person, this role offers a clear route from Personal Injury Legal Assistant into specialist Data Breach work, with increasing responsibility and opportunities to progress within the team.
